justification: Inspected jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileFactory.java, jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/JimfsFileStore.java, jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java, jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/JimfsFileSystems.java, and jimfs/src/test/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileFactoryTest.java.
